about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of an established Corporate Service Provider in Malta for an experienced and motivated Senior Corporate Administrator to join its Corporate Services team in Birkirkara.

You will take ownership of a client portfolio and manage company incorporations, resolutions, share transfers, statutory filings and other corporate changes. The role also involves overseeing Junior Corporate Administrators, maintaining accurate records and supporting more complex matters such as mergers, re-domiciliations and company divisions.

This full-time, on-site position is suited to a corporate services professional who already resides in Malta, understands Malta Business Registry procedures and can provide reliable support to clients and junior colleagues. The gross salary is €35,000 per year.
responsibilities: Manage a portfolio of clients and ensure compliance with statutory obligations, including Annual Returns and Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmations
Handle day-to-day company administration, including incorporations, resolutions, share transfers and other corporate changes
Oversee and support Junior Corporate Administrators, reviewing corporate registers, share certificates and related documentation
Maintain accurate and current corporate records and ensure timely submissions to the Malta Business Registry
Monitor compliance with the Companies Act and applicable statutory filing requirements
Assist the Head of Corporate with local and cross-border mergers, re-domiciliations and company divisions
Liaise with clients on corporate administration matters and provide professional, timely support
Prepare documentation and coordinate submissions for on-site inspections by the Malta Business Registry
Update internal systems with client information, corporate actions and regulatory submissions
Manage the registration and ongoing administration of Scottish Partnerships
Prepare and submit annual confirmation statements and tax status declarations for Scottish Partnerships and their partners
Liaise with UK-based agents and other relevant stakeholders
Assist with additional tasks and projects assigned by Partners and Directors
